biography: Carlito Miracco, a name synonymous with daring overtakes and the flash of British motorsport, hails from a small village in Oxfordshire. Unlike many racers groomed from karting academies, Carlito's path was unconventional. He began his competitive journey in demolition derbies, honing his car control amidst the chaos and carnage. It was at a local dirt track that a scout from the 'U' racing team spotted his raw talent and reckless abandon. His early years with 'U' were a rollercoaster, punctuated by spectacular crashes and occasional flashes of brilliance. A defining moment came at the Silverstone Grand Prix, where, despite starting from the back of the grid, he carved his way through the field to finish third, cementing his place as a rising star. Now, at 36, Carlito is considered to be in the prime of his career, consistently challenging for podiums and captivating fans with his aggressive style.
drivingStyle: Carlito's driving style is best described as 'controlled chaos'. He's renowned for his late braking and fearless overtaking maneuvers, often threading the needle where others wouldn't dare. He isn't always the smoothest, often wrestling the car, but his raw speed and ability to extract every last tenth of a second from the machinery is undeniable. Tire management is a known weakness, often pushing too hard early in a stint, but his aggressive corner entry speeds and willingness to take risks frequently compensate for any degradation.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Rossi
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at the Monaco Grand Prix, where Carlito's aggressive move took both drivers out of the race.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A battle for the championship title in 2022 saw several on-track clashes and accusations of unsportsmanlike conduct between Carlito and Kenji.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: Bellini has always been critical of Carlito's perceived recklessness, leading to heated exchanges in press conferences and on social media.

quirks: Always wears a lucky pair of socks gifted to him by his grandmother before every race.
Refuses to eat anything green on race days.
Listens to a specific heavy metal song (very loudly) exactly 30 minutes before getting into the car.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. I'm here to win, or I'm here to crash trying."
careerHighlight: Winning the Italian Grand Prix at Monza in 2021 after a thrilling last-lap battle with Isabelle Rossi, solidifying his reputation as a top-tier driver.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2020, costing his team a likely victory and earning him considerable criticism.
